patch_list: Stops the Play Store from silently replacing the patched app with the official version, which would bring the ads back. It raises the app's version number far ahead of the Store's, so the Store sees it as up to date. You can still update o…
Stops the Apple TV phone app from playing ad interstitials in on-demand videos. Promos and bumpers delivered the same way are skipped too. Experimental; test on-device.
